## Verification

Record the actual complete canonical gate results for this exact tree, first failures, skips and remaining blockers. The governance phase has nine required checks and no application, font, build or browser acceptance. Later application integration needs its own complete phase policy and execution evidence.

## Review and protected merge

Record matching scanner execution, native Sonar quality gate, complete all-severity zero-unresolved evidence and substantive CodeRabbit review. A provider success or signal workflow alone does not establish an approving review. Protected merge requires the separate `CodeRabbit approval` status from the trusted verifier, plus the provider `CodeRabbit` check and ordinary native review protections.

The trusted default-branch workflows cannot enforce their own first introduction into a README-only default branch. Report missing bootstrap checks honestly; do not publish a synthetic passing status or merge without separately authorized resolution.
